day_shape: 61 items: CENTCOM sinks M/T Kylo in Gulf of Oman after striking three Iranian tankers including near Kharg Island, IDF resumes southern Lebanon strikes after Hezbollah drone launches (4 dead per Lebanese authorities), Qalibaf declares end of 'proportionate responses', nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: US tanker strikes and Gulf naval escalation
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced the M/T Kylo sank in the Gulf of Oman after US forces struck three Iranian oil tankers Saturday, including one off Kharg Island, with Adm. Brad Cooper warning of a 3-for-2 retaliation formula. JD Vance defended the Strait of Hormuz operations, and the IRGC claimed via Jerusalem Post reporting that it targeted three tankers and three US-affiliated ships in response.

threads.label: Iran ports and blockade pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported satellite imagery showing sharp drops in shipping activity at Shahid Rajaee and Imam Khomeini ports since the US naval blockade was reimposed in mid-July. A former NSC chief told Jerusalem Post six to nine months of sustained economic pressure could push Iranians into the streets.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strikes after Hezbollah drones
threads.summary: The IDF said Hezbollah launched two explosive drones at troops in the security zone, prompting airstrikes across southern Lebanon; Lebanese authorities reported four dead and 20 wounded, and Lebanese media said Ghandour Hospital in Nabatieh al-Fawqa was destroyed while empty. Defence Minister Katz said Israeli forces will not leave the security zone until Hezbollah is disarmed, following the reported fall of Ali al-Taher.

threads.label: Tehran defiance messaging
threads.summary: Parliament Speaker Qalibaf declared via IRIB and Defa Press that 'the era of proportionate responses has come to an end' and any violation would receive a 'faster, heavier and more painful' response. Admiral Siahri told Defa Press Iran's deterrent capability had increased, while Khamenei's office posted Unity Week messaging and an infographic of 'forty demands' for an 'ever stronger' Iran.

threads.label: Gaza casualty figures and diplomacy
threads.summary: IRIB cited the Gaza Health Ministry putting the death toll at 73,651 with 174,500 wounded, and Shehab reporting 100 bodies recovered from al-Zaytoun rubble. Three mediating diplomats told Times of Israel they do not expect the Hamas disarmament timeline to hold due to Israeli opposition.

threads.label: Iran domestic and elite politics
threads.summary: Iran International reported hardline cleric Ahmad Alamolhoda is seeking the presidency of the 88-member Assembly of Experts, and that two London penthouses linked to Mojtaba Khamenei worth £36 million have been put up for sale per the Sunday Times. Defa Press reported President Pezeshkian ordered an investigation into a Kurdistan fuel tanker explosion.

threads.label: US posture and Natanz threat
threads.summary: Iran International noted Trump repeated on Friday that the US may strike Pickaxe Mountain near Natanz, the last major untouched nuclear site. IRIB cited Guardian reporting on Pentagon strain under Pete Hegseth with roughly 50,000 US personnel and 19 vessels in the region, and cited former CIA director Petraeus saying US bases east of the Persian Gulf are no longer usable.
